models: exact five issue19 sym_wrap final checkpoints; hashes frozen before evaluation

statistics.unit: five training seeds; average evaluation seeds and trials within each
statistics.bootstrap: exact all 3125 paired seed resamples; percentile 95%
statistics.censoring: paired first-episode prefix; retain falls and exposure; never join yaw across resets

prerequisite.S_gate: for every command, abs(mean of five seed S means) <=5 degrees; additionally report all per-seed values and intervals
prerequisite.halfcycle_swap: signed yaw is axial: k10 left equals negative k0 right and k10 right equals negative k0 left; paired five-seed bootstrap95 swap-residual intervals must include zero; report numerical per-trial residuals without hiding divergences
prerequisite.failure: classify simulator_not_equivariant, report and stop further original-USD factorial evaluation; suggest simulator investigation

classification.Phi: original forward05 S CI excludes zero and P>=0.5 and symmetric USD S CI includes zero
classification.Gamma: original P<0.5 or original S CI includes zero; abs(D)>=20 degrees in at least3 of5 training seeds and D sign agrees across USD for each seed

halfcycle: actual pre-action (episode step+k)%20; complete cycles only, left bins0..9/right10..19, report phase-shifted prefix and exposure separately
video: forward05 seed with maximum abs seed-mean D; paired same trial, k0/k10 overhead side-by-side worldXY plus colored front and side; exact-state replay; if prerequisite fails choose from symmetric USD and label early stop
scope: No training, reward change, default change, extra experiments or parameter scan. Causal background statements remain hypotheses.
